duration: Sunday, November 15, 2026 in America/Chicago. Each row expires at its own kickoff; the saved price requires a personal recheck.
method: Editorial ranking for the November 15 Chicago slate. Start with documented football cases from the release review and independent red team. Look for repeatable opportunity or team strength, assess what changed in personnel and opponent, then compare two-sided exact-line prices at the captured US books. Rank the combined football and price case. A price or historical hit rate alone cannot determine rank. One contract per game keeps shared game scripts from dominating this five-row list. Volatility is qualitative sensitivity to role, personnel or a small number of possessions; no statistical variance was estimated.
